summary: A reporter tells an official what the published story alleges before asking for a response.
realLife: At a White House briefing a reporter attributed a claim about the timing of a secretary’s briefing to the New York Times and asked about future orders. Sean Spicer disputed the newspaper’s account.
inGame: scandal-call-printed.test.ts checks the printed story behind the call.
gates: The allegation has appeared in a story.

turns.what: The reporter identifies the story and asks whether the official has seen it.
turns.pulledBy: The publication arrived while the official was in session.
turns.writesBack: The official requests a copy before answering the allegation.

turns.what: The reporter reads the claim over the phone, and the member asks to see the edition it appeared in before answering.
turns.pulledBy: The article has changed online since the print edition went out.
turns.writesBack: The reporter sends the dated clipping and records the response against that version.
